signatureEngine.name: 钢铁肉垫
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 合金猫爪
refinements.description: 物理伤害提升20%；从背后攻击命中敌人时，装备者造成的伤害提升25%。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Physical DMG by 20%. The equipper's DMG increases by 25% when hitting the enemy from behind.

refinements.name: 合金猫爪
refinements.description: 物理伤害提升25%；从背后攻击命中敌人时，装备者造成的伤害提升31.5%。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Physical DMG by 25%. The equipper's DMG increases by 31.5% when hitting the enemy from behind.

refinements.name: 合金猫爪
refinements.description: 物理伤害提升30%；从背后攻击命中敌人时，装备者造成的伤害提升38%。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Physical DMG by 30%. The equipper's DMG increases by 38% when hitting the enemy from behind.

refinements.name: 合金猫爪

refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Physical DMG by 35%. The equipper's DMG increases by 44% when hitting the enemy from behind.

refinements.name: 合金猫爪
refinements.description: 物理伤害提升40%；从背后攻击命中敌人时，装备者造成的伤害提升50%。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Physical DMG by 40%. The equipper's DMG increases by 50% when hitting the enemy from behind.

basic.name: 普通攻击：猫猫爪刺
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
发动最后一段斩击时，有33.33%的概率重复攻击三次。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
On the last hit, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this hit 3 times.

special.name: 特殊技：奇袭
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行下落打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：超~凶奇袭！
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力下落斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash that deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：虚影双刺
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：刃爪挥击
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：刃爪强袭
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：借用猫爪
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：应激防御
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：迅影
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升60%，持续6秒。
facts.textEn: When Nekomata's Dodge Counter or Quick Assist hits an enemy, her DMG increases by 60% for 6s.

cinema.name: 猎鸟技巧
cinema.description: 从背后攻击命中敌人时，猫又无视目标16%物理伤害抗性；敌方处于失衡状态时，猫又对其的所有攻击均被视为背后攻击。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's Physical RES. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.

cinema.name: 猫鼠游戏
cinema.description: 当场上只有一名敌人且自身位于前场时，猫又的能量获得效率提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.

cinema.name: 好奇的左尾
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 磨爪
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，猫又的暴击率提升7%，最多叠加2层，持续15秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata uses her EX Special Attack, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.

cinema.name: 幸运的右尾
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 捕食者血统
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，猫又的暴击伤害提升18%，最多叠加3层，退出接战状态时增益效果结束；猫又击败敌人时，该增益效果直接叠加至层数上限。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nekomata launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
